blocs.texte: Hi, Grace! | Do you want to go cycling on Saturday?
At half past nine. | We can meet in the park.
I can't. | I have a swimming lesson at quarter past nine. | It finishes at quarter past ten.
That's fine. | But I don't want to cycle if it rains.
Then we can go to the cinema.
Good idea. | My brother wants to see a new film, but he has football practice at half past eleven.
Let's ask him first. | What do you usually do on Sundays?
I do my homework in the morning. | In the afternoon, I visit my grandparents. | They live in a village near the town.
I usually go shopping with my mother, but this Sunday we're staying at home
